author: Brodie Robertson | Linux Tips & Tricks
description:
The window manager space on Wayland has completely changed over the past few years, there was a time when Sway was the only good choice but now you have both Hyprland a dynamic tiler and Niri a scroller and this has changed the equation for what you can do on Wayland.
